<!-- pr-reviewer: 267551d8b2792f843e9c0db3108be1197b204ac6 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks for the contribution, @seelesturm.

**What looks good**
- Advisory only: it is stored in existing toolpath notes, and no moves, serialized variants, project-format version or dependencies change. No build.rs, .github, scripts or Cargo changes.
- No unwrap/expect/panic outside tests. Float-to-index casts in `top_stock.rs` are floored, clamped or bounded. Non-finite and unknown prior data stay as a warning and are never treated as clearance.
- Regional (not global) stock-top reading, with credit only for analytic box/cylinder stock.
- Provenance line present, decision file in `docs/decisions/`, `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #104` present, and no CHANGELOG.md edit. The snapshot PNGs are changed and explained in the body.

**Local results (trial-merged with current main, clean merge)**
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `--lib` | 84 passed |
| app `--test top_stock` | 4 passed |
| app `--test operations` | 117 passed, 6 ignored |
| ui `--lib` (CWD crates/ui) | 259 passed, 2 ignored |
| ui `--test egui_app` (3 changed snapshots) | 3 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- This is labelled `feat`, so per Issue Law it merges at the next minor cut.
- `generate.rs` is 3140 lines, already far over the ~400 limit. The PR adds a few lines to it (the new logic is correctly in its own module).
- The `Section::Mill2D | Mill3D` call-site formatting is dense and rustfmt-unfriendly; cosmetic only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
